title: 7 Best Lovable Alternatives in 2026 (Honest, Tested Comparison)
summary: Lovable is excellent for fast UI prototyping, but its separate Supabase database, 100-credit cap, and no built-in auth push builders to look elsewhere. 7 honest alternatives, tested.
body_markdown: Lovable's default UI aesthetic is excellent — its fine-tuned prompts for visual polish are one of the reasons the tool is popular. Blink generates competitive quality using frontier models (Claude Opus, GPT-5, Gemini), but Lovable edges ahead on first-draft aesthetics for marketing-heavy interfaces. The practical trade-off: Blink's output includes a working backend immediately, while Lovable's polished frontend still needs Supabase and Clerk wired in before it is a functional app. For most production projects, a working backend matters more than cosmetic polish at first draft.
